description.id: Ringkasan naratif 25 nabi yang disusun SELA dari ayat-ayat Al-Qur’an yang dirujuk, dengan rujukan di setiap bagian. Belum ditelaah ulama.
description.en: Narrative summaries of the 25 prophets written by SELA from the cited Quran passages, with references on every section. Not yet reviewed by scholars.
